method: Compose a soundscape from user-selected natural sound objects.
Treat each selected object as a small cluster of spatialized voices rather than one static loop.
Randomize loop start, playback rate, gain, stereo/panner position, filter frequency, and event timing to avoid repetition.
Apply mood as a master mix layer that changes density, brightness, tempo, reverb, and per-source balance.
Measure each decoded web recording and apply automatic loudness normalization so quiet chirps and louder water beds sit in the same mix.
Load a 50-sample web-derived pool per icon and randomly choose from that pool whenever a source is activated.
